claims: No. 9 seed USC Trojans defeated No. 8 seed Clemson Tigers 71-67.
The game was a first-round game in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
Jazzy Davidson scored 31 points for USC Trojans.
USC Trojans advance to the second round.
Taylor Johnson-Matthews scored 16 points for Clemson Tigers.
Kara Dunn scored 22 points for USC Trojans.
Raven Thompson scored 11 points for Clemson Tigers.
Raven Thompson had 12 rebounds for Clemson Tigers.
The game was the first-ever matchup between USC Trojans and Clemson Tigers.
The game was the first NCAA Tournament overtime win for USC Trojans.
Clemson Tigers trailed 64-61 with 2:34 left in overtime.
Jazzy Davidson hit a 3-pointer to tie the game for USC Trojans in overtime.
